skill_name: Create a blog post of 300 words discussing how AI has impacted the logistics and supply chain industry.
workflow: The logistics and supply chain industry is quickly being disrupted by the rise of artificial intelligence (AI). With the help of AI, companies are able to streamline mundane tasks, such as ordering, tracking, and delivery, to improve the overall efficiency of their operations. AI-driven technologies such as machine learning (ML) helps to analyze massive amounts of data to better predict customer needs and optimize inventory levels.
